title: Unpublishing a dropped page's template article (state 0) leaves no look guard finding; any other state still does
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: content.update of a template article with fields { state: 0 } through the look guard gives no finding and no refusal.
state 1, -2 or 2 on a template article gives one finding naming 'only unpublishing (state 0) is open on article 6'.

tests: unpublishing a template article (state 0) is open to the write step and leaves no look guard finding
publishing or trashing a template article is still a look guard finding
